主要内容: KENTUCKY BANCSHARES INC, a U.S. based company, filed a Form 8-K on January 31, 2014, to disclose its intention to mail quarterly financial information for the fourth quarter of 2013 to its shareholders on or about February 7, 2014. The filing includes a copy of the mailing as Exhibit 99.1. The report also includes forward-looking statements, which are subject to various risks such as changes in economic conditions, regulatory enforcement, monetary and fiscal policies, interest rates, and demand for financial services. The company's annual report on Form 10-K and other filings are available on the SEC website. This report is a 8-K filing by KENTUCKY BANCSHARES INC, dated January 31, 2014. The filing is related to the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, and it was signed by Gregory J. Dawson, the Chief Financial Officer of the company. The report is associated with the company's website, www.kybank.com. The filing indicates that the company has fulfilled the requirements of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 by signing the report on behalf of the registrant. This filing is a standard regulatory filing and does not provide specific financial or operational details beyond the required disclosures.
